d.blurb:
This remaster revisits an open-world crime game in which the Third Street Saints, once a street gang, are now a household brand. Their fame draws the attention of the Syndicate, a criminal fraternity that demands tribute, and the Saints refuse to kneel, taking the fight to Syndicate forces across the city of Steelport.

The update refreshes the visuals with better lighting, rebuilt environments and new effects. The game embraces outrageous, over-the-top humor and mature content, with a sandbox of missions and activities to roam through. You can play alone or team up in online co-op, and full controller support is included. It suits players who prefer chaotic, irreverent action to a serious crime drama.
